hypothesis: Preserving original Cartesian 5-point interior flux with a symmetric exact inclined-Neumann cut-Q1 roof closure may improve original point-q0 grid behavior, but previous exact-roof Q1 did not converge; failure is an admissible outcome.
preregistration: This file is committed and pushed before evaluating any new hybrid-operator numerical results. Fixed geometry, operator coefficient, nodes, all-five q0 gates and diagnostics; no post-hoc exclusions.

original.q0: original real comms_out.h5 in_sigs[:,0] eight nodes, in_sigs[:,1:]=0; no smoothing or fitting

new_operator.geometry: 0<=x,y<=4, 0<=z<=4-0.25y, exactly clipped polygons in original native y/z Cartesian Q1 basis
new_operator.yz_mass: full previously exact positive consistent physical cut-Q1 mass M, no positive mass floors/drops
new_operator.yz_stiffness: K=K_cutQ1 + (c^2/3) sum over every FULL wet original native y-z rectangle (e00-e10-e01+e11)(same)^T; partial roof/physical-wall-cut rectangles receive NO penalty and retain exact Q1 flux; scalar coefficient is algebraically UNIQUE for converting an uncut full Q1 element stiffness to four half-weight Cartesian axis fluxes; no fitted parameter
new_operator.derivation: On an uncut h×h element Q1 local K has diagonal 2c²/3, edge -c²/6, opposite -c²/3; + c²/3 ssT yields diagonal c², edge -c²/2, opposite 0. Affine and constants annihilated by sT, symmetric rank-one PSD increment.
new_operator.full_3D: M=Mx(P1 physically exact) tensor Myz(Q1); K=Kx tensor Myz + Mx tensor Kyz_hybrid; all eigenmodes retained
new_operator.source_receiver: original 8 native indices and HDF5 weights mapped identically to existing cut-Q1, x original P1 nodes, no interpolation changes
new_operator.time_scheme: native dt beta=1/4 Newmark full linear spectrum and original full 250ms forward/center/backward pressure derivative, 40/80Hz signed finite rectangular record

independent.analytic_roof_tangent_affine: u(y,z)=y-0.25z: n=(.25,1)/sqrt(1+.25²) yields roof normal derivative=0; test roof-only weak Ku small on each grid
